description: ms-swift 4.5.3 loads a model's auto_map through transformers trust_remote_code. A model directory controlled by a tenant executes Python in the training/inference process when the victim loads it.

params_schema.target: 目标 URL，例如 http://host:port（真实模式必需）
params_schema.mode: probe-only（默认，只读探测）| backup-write（写模块需 backup_targets）
params_schema.local_path: function-level 模块的本地文件/模型目录（仅读取，不反序列化）
